title: The Third Measure
author: The local archive of {city_name}
text: The old wardens measured a road by the places where you could drink and rest. That's how our town book tells it. If your travels take you to {dungeon_name}, will you copy the archive inscription? Read our account first. I'd like to know whether they counted as we did.
ledger_prompt: Copy the shared-measure account from the town book in {city_name} before setting out.
inscription: A measure is entered only where water is offered and a traveler can rest.
finding: Water and a place to rest count in both accounts. The old wardens used the same measure here and there.
completion: Water and a place to sit. I'm glad those words lasted. I'll put your copy in the town book. Sit down while I find the ink.
